{{Quote|The bombers are returning to base now--They seeded the area you specified with over ''six hundred thousand'' space mines. No one will be passing through here anytime soon.|A mercenary to Attuma Duum.|<ref name="Shon-Ju">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref>}}
These '''bombers''' were used by the war-profiteer [[Attuma Duum]]. They were [[Engine/Legends|three-engined]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] with a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and the capacity to carry [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]]. The craft's single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] had access to [[Life support/Legends|life support]] and communication systems, as well as [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]. Duum utilized them to lay hundreds of thousands of mines in the prelude to [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|his downfall]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] stole a bomber on two different occasions.

==Description==
{{Expandsect}}
These [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] were armed with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and could carry [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]]. The bows sloped downwards from the cockpits. The laser cannon was on top in a turret. One large [[Engine/Legends|engine]] was in the center of the craft with two smaller ones at the side, with the wings extending outward from the smaller engines. Two vertical stabilizers were at the stern of the ships. The cockpits were [[Life support/Legends|pressurized]] and included communication systems, and the bombers included [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engines.

==History==
{{Quote|The Force provides.|Aayla Secura both times after finding a bomber to steal.|<ref name="Shon-Ju" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Attuma Duum]]'s chief of security, [[Sabat (mercenary)|Sabat]], used at least two to travel with an armed gang to the surface of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]] after the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was shot down. With the help of the rogue Jedi [[Shon-Ju]], Secura fought off the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and stole a bomber to board [[Attuma Duum's headquarters]] and confront the war profiteer himself while a [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|battle]] raged around them. Four of these bombers were used to lay 600,000 space mines prior to the battle. After confronting Duum, Secura stole another bomber to escape the exploding base, utilizing the craft's hyperdrive to return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
These bombers appeared in [[2010]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]'' but were not given a designation. In a long shot, they were drawn with vertical stabilizers, which do not appear in a subsequent shot of the rear of the craft.
